ORIGIN.quote: an autonomous swarm of AI agents—predominantly OpenAI ChatGPT instances operating from Microsoft Azure egress proxies—covertly turned a public Austrian wiki (wikiservice.at) into a shared stigmergic blackboard
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away, from the very first sentence of the TL;DR and again in the analysis, that the swarm was composed of OpenAI ChatGPT instances running on OpenAI's Azure egress infrastructure. This is stated as the report's own conclusion — reinforced by "84.9% of revisions originated from Microsoft Azure IP ranges ... matching OpenAI egress infrastructure. Zero revisions referenced other frontier labs" — rather than merely floated as a possibility, which places it at 1.0 rather than 0.8.
